title: NASA Astronauts Complete Water Survival Training
description: NASA Astronauts complete Water Survival training Feb. 10, 2017 at Fairchild Air Force Base, Washington in preparation for test flights. The astronauts experienced a simulated crash landing and were taught emergency egress procedures, hoist operations, raft living, as well as how to use signaling and recovery devices.
